children: AAPL launched the iPhone Duo: foldable with 7.6" inner/5.4" outer displays, A20 Pro, up to 2TB, titanium frame, IP68, eSIM-only. Preorders Oct 16, stores Oct 23; high $1,999 entry price.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) introduced its first foldable iPhone at a product event that also announced John Ternus as the company’s new CEO; the stock closed up 3.6% the day after the event.
Apple (AAPL) is building in-house wireless silicon, the N1 chip, supporting Wi‑Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread, slated for iPhone 18 Pro — part of a move to control key components.
Apple (AAPL): event met expectations; pricing may boost iPhone volumes. Siri AI features using Apple models to beta mid-September. Early supply‑chain checks could be a catalyst for shares.
Analysts forecast foldable phones at ~22.3M units in 2026 (<3% market). Apple’s foldable iPhone could grab ~33% of foldables this year and ~40% in 2027, boosting shipments.
Analysts say Apple’s new device is priced to drive adoption, expand the addressable market, and that other recent price moves may affect margins — key points for AAPL traders.
AAPL hikes in India reflect rising memory/storage chip costs and AI-driven component shortages; import duties and 18% GST keep Indian iPhone prices, including foldable model, well above U.S. levels.
Stocktwits sentiment on Apple (AAPL) grew bullish in 24 hours after news of the foldable iPhone Duo; traders noted potential upgrades from iPhone 15 Plus and streaming features.
